title: Paste Pasta
features:
This is an autofarm gui made by me, everything was written by me from the ground up except for 1 line to select a pet for the multi select
I made this because pretty much every script for this game is not original or stole a chunk of gerard's source code which preston has a detection for. 

there are no useless vanity features like shitty fireworks or disabling the open anim, but I also didn't add an egg opener (yet) because I spent 4 hours on this

the thumbnail of this script is snippets of every popular script except for petsi, which stole gerard's source
